description_en: Queries the resources that are associated with a tag option
description_zh: 查询标签选项关联的资源列表
kebab_example: aliyun servicecatalog list-resources-for-tag-option --tag-option-id tag-bp1u6mdf3d0000 --resource-type Product --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListResourcesForTagOption

parameters.help_en: The ID of the tag option
parameters.name: tag_option_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of resource that is associated with the tag option. Valid values:

product: product

Portfolio: product portfolio
parameters.help_zh:
标签选项关联的资源类型。取值：

Product：产品。
Portfolio：产品组合
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en:
The number of the page to return.

Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
页码。

起始值：1。默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page.

Valid values: 1 to 100 Minimum value: 1. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页时每页显示的数据行数。

取值范围：1~100。起始值：1。默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

PageNumber.description_en:
The page number of the returned page.

Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1
PageNumber.description_zh:
页码。

起始值：1。默认值：1

PageSize.description_en:
The number of entries returned per page.

Valid values: 1 to 100 Minimum value: 1. Default value: 10
PageSize.description_zh:
分页时每页显示的数据行数。

取值范围：1~100。起始值：1。默认值：10

ResourceDetails.description_en: An array that consists of the associated resources

CreateTime.description_en:
The time when the resource was created.

The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
CreateTime.description_zh:
资源创建时间。

按照ISO8601标准表示，使用UTC时间，格式：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ

Description.description_en:
The description of the resource.

The value must be 1 to 128 characters in length
Description.description_zh:
资源描述。

长度为1~128个字符

ResourceArn.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the resource

ResourceId.description_en: The ID of the resource with which the tag option is associated

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
